scripts.api:generate: pnpm --filter contract generate && pnpm --filter client generate:sdk
scripts.build: pnpm api:generate && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:generate && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- contract/generated client/src/api/generated)"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm api:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
